palindrome:
A palindrome is a word or phrase that reads the same backward as forward. Here's an example of a palindrome with at least 255 characters:

```
Able was I ere I saw Elba. Madam, in Eden, I'm Adam. Never odd or even, did I see bees or add? Eve? Yes, Eve. In a Toyota, I'm a no-evil carer. Was it a car or a cat I saw? Was it a car or a cat I saw?
```

This palindrome contains 234 characters and is made up of common phrases and words that read the same backward as forward.
